static_traits.name: 温德琳
static_traits.family_status: 原生家庭：独生Female；Mother为主日学老师；Not mentioned父亲情况与其他家庭成员
static_traits.social_status: 与护理学校的同学与导师关系受其贬低自我成就的倾向影响；与朋友关系较亲近，但尚not yet就此议题与朋友讨论
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；without既往心理治疗或相关求助经历；此前not yet报告类似心理问题
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、配合度Good，能具体举例；在被赞美时倾向于快速Displacement话题并淡化成就；情绪体验为“压力大、感到not适”；语速与逻辑结构Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: 我倾向于贬低自己的成就，尤其是我在芭蕾方面获得的奖项，这使我感到not足并降低我对成功的评价。在收到赞美或认可时尤为明显，影响我的自我价值与动力。
basic_info.core_demands: 希望能not再贬低自己的成就，更加全面、现实地看待与欣赏自己的成功，提升自我价值感与学习动力。
growth_experiences: 原生家庭信息：独生Female，Mother为主日学老师（其他家庭成员与成长事件Not mentioned）。
曾在芭蕾方面获得过奖项（具体次数与时间Not mentioned）。

special_situations.event: Praised and recognized by others after winning a ballet award
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的表现not是顶尖或完美，就not值得被认可；他人的赞美可能只是礼貌而非真实评价
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 迅速Displacement话题、淡化或negate成就，将成功归因于运气
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is just luck, anyone could do it; they are just being polite

special_situations.event: 在护理考试中取得Good成绩后收到肯定
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not是满分或远超他人，就说明not够好、not值得自我肯定
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 刻意贬低成绩，not允许自己停留在正面体验中

special_situations.event: Friends or peers express appreciation for one's contribution to the team
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果他人比我更优秀，我的贡献就微not足道
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 比较他人的长处并negate自身价值，减少自我表达
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 总有人更好，我的贡献not重要

special_situations.event: In a high-pressure period of balancing nursing studies, personal life, and ballet training
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果without法把所有领域都兼顾到高标准，就说明我not够能力
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Intensifies self-berating, downplays progress and achievements made
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我配not上这些赞美，not值得被认可

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be genuinely seen and recognized, expecting one's efforts and achievements to be fairly evaluated
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被认为not配被认可、被揭穿“只是运气”的感觉，担心他人评价并negate自己
defense_goal: 通过negate或淡化成就来保持谦逊与安全感，避免暴露“not配”的Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的成就者/Student，容易自我贬低
object_relations.object_representation: Others are polite praisers or potential harsh critics
同伴与导师对自己的赞美not可靠/可能只是敷衍

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When others praise one's ballet award or academic performance
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将他人的赞美理解为not真诚的客套，认为自己的成功靠运气（移情：将内在的“not配感”Projection到他人的意图）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气温和与Empathy，use开放式Questioning探究其努力与证据，避免直接反驳；邀请具体例子以连接实际付出与成果。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites one to stay with the positive feeling of being praised
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将停留在积极体验理解为not适与危险，担心暴露“not够好”
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以低强度、循序渐进的方式邀请命名感受，use短时停留练习与安全界限，逐步扩大对积极体验的容许度。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 在学习与生活Increased stress且需要他人肯定时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将自我价值系于高标准，认为not yet达完美即“not够好”
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 减少抽象评判，转向具体化与当下体验的描述；鼓励识do not努力的行为证据，并以温和语气连接情感与事实。

manifestations: 对芭蕾获奖与学业成绩的意义感降低，认为“这not算什么/只是运气/任何人都能做到”
难以停留在自我肯定的体验中，倾向于淡化与deny正面的自我叙事
outcomes: Interpersonal relationships受影响（与同学与导师的互动变差）

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: 在收到赞美时快速Displacement话题
对积极反馈not做停留，回避当下的正面体验

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 以“必须更好/永远not够”的高标准评判自我
Treats perfectionist standards as the only criterion for being recognized

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Excessively harsh on one's own contributions and achievements
Underestimates self-worth in relationships, cautious to the point of finding it hard to accept positive feedback

positive_force: Performance in nursing studies is acceptable (satisfied with academic functioning)
芭蕾方面获得过奖项，具备投入与skill
Close relationships with friends, potential support resources exist
Proactively seeks counseling and is willing to try change (motivation and openness)
negative_force: 倾向于negate与贬低正向结果（Disqualifying the Positive）
Self-demands are too high; black-and-white standards and frequent comparison
在被赞美时感到not适并回避（快速Displacement话题）
学业与生活Increased stress，导致自我照顾与Decline in sense of well-being

target_behavior.behavior: 在获得成就或被赞美时，自动化地贬低与deny自我成就（如称其为运气、快速Displacement话题）
antecedent: Being praised by others after winning a ballet award
护理考试取得Good成绩并受到肯定
Friends or peers express appreciation for one's contributions
target_behavior.core_reason: 受“I am not good enough/not值得被认可”的核心信念与高标准比较驱动，为避免暴露“not配”的Anxiety而回避正向自我评价
target_behavior.function: 逃避not适情绪与被评价的感受，维持表面上的安全与谦逊感
target_behavior.consequence: 自我价值感与Decreased drive、Interpersonal relationships受影响、自我照顾与整体幸福感降低
